project_info.name: NADI (Navigasi Data Bisnis)
project_info.tagline: Catat transaksi. Pahami data. Ambil keputusan lebih cerdas.
project_info.target_audience: UMKM Indonesia (Warung kopi/kedai, toko kelontong/retail, usaha makanan/kuliner, bisnis rumahan)
project_info.theme_archetype: Organic Earthy + Swiss Precision (Clean SaaS dengan aksen warna khas Indonesia: Putih + Hijau Nusantara + Emas Warm)

color_palette.mode: Light-first with warm modern SaaS aesthetic

primary.description: Hijau Nusantara - Signifies prosperity, freshness, and sustainable local business growth

secondary_gold.description: Emas Panen Warm Gold - Used for key highlights, AI recommendations, profit indicators, and badges

background.description: Warm bone white / soft warm canvas

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, monospace (for Rp / monetary totals & transaction numbers)

navigation.header_bar: Sticky glassmorphism header (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-stone-200/70 z-40) with business switcher, quick POS button, and AI alert icon
navigation.mobile_nav: Bottom fixed navigation bar with touch-friendly targets for quick mobile cashiering

components: Brand Hero Banner with value proposition 'Catat transaksi. Pahami data. Ambil keputusan lebih cerdas.'
Business Category Selector (Kuliner / Warkop, Retail & Kelontong, Fashion, Jasa, Lainnya)
Quick Switch Demo Mode button ('Masuk Mode Demo Kedai Kopi Nadi')
Ringkasan Hari Ini KPI Grid (Omzet Hari Ini, Est. Keuntungan Bersih, Jumlah Transaksi, Produk Terlaris)
Grafik Penjualan 7 Hari (Recharts Line/Area Chart showing daily revenue vs estimated profit)
AI Insights Carousel / Highlight Banner ('Rekomendasi NADI')
Peringatan Stok Menipis (Low stock alert cards with quick reorder action button)
Transaksi Terakhir (Recent sales list with instant detail drawer)
POS Cashier Layout: Left grid category filter & product tiles with photos + stock count
Right Order Cart Panel: Item list, quantity modifier, discount input, payment method selector (Tunai, QRIS, Transfer), and big 'Proses Pembayaran' CTA button
Struk Digital / Modal Struk Cetak after checkout complete
Product CRUD Table & Grid view switcher
Category tabs (Minuman, Makanan, Biji Kopi, Snacking, Bahan Baku)
Low stock highlight filter & Quick Add Product Modal with HPP (Harga Pokok) & Harga Jual auto-margin calculation
Tren Pendapatan & Profitability Area Chart
Analisis Waktu Ramai (Peak sales day & hour bar chart)
Kontribusi Kategori Produk (Donut / Pie Chart)
Peringkat Produk Terlaris & Margin Tertinggi Table
Asisten NADI Interactive AI Advisor Chat & Card Feed
Kartu Rekomendasi Strategis (E.g. 'Bundling Paket Hemat Kopi + Roti', 'Penyesuaian Stok Biji Kopi Arabika', 'Promo Jam Sepi')
Tombol 'Terapkan Rekomendasi' for direct automated promo or stock order action
Filter Periode (Harian, Mingguan, Bulanan, Custom)
Laporan Laba Rugi Sederhana (Revenue - COGS - Expenses = Net Profit)
Download / Print PDF Export Preview
Informasi Usaha (Nama Kedai, Alamat, Logo, Kategori UMKM)
Pengaturan Struk (Catatan Kaki Struk, Header QRIS)
Manajemen Staf / Kasir

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based, e.g., data-testid='nav-dashboard-link', data-testid='pos-add-to-cart-btn-p1', data-testid='ai-insight-card-1', data-testid='transaction-checkout-btn'
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_wcag: All text elements maintain minimum 4.5:1 ratio against warm stone-50 background or white card backgrounds
testing_and_accessibility.interactive_states: Hover, focus, active, and disabled states MUST explicitly define text colors and background transitions

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, responsive, startup-competition-worthy frontend application prototype for NADI.
Ensure all 8 requested pages/tabs are accessible via navigation and functional.
Incorporate real state management so users can add products, record transactions, see real-time chart updates, and interact with the AI NADI recommendations.
Use Lucide icons, Recharts for analytics, Framer Motion for smooth tab and toast interactions, and Sonner for toasts.
Maintain Indonesian language throughout every single UI component, label, error message, and AI text.
